history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration review the incumbency of geographical posts temporarily occupied by staff without geographical status and make the necessary system changes.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented through changes to the regulatory framework and the Administration therefore requests closure. The Under- Secretary-General for Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance issued a revised administrative instruction on the administration of appointments (ST/AI/2025/3), effective 1 November 2025, which introduced substantive regulatory changes directly addressing the issue raised by the Board. In particular, the revised administrative instruction consolidates and harmonizes previously fragmented provisions governing the use of liens, clarifying that liens are exceptional and time-bound arrangements and introducing transitional measures to prevent their indefinite extension. By strengthening the regulatory framework on lien management, the instruction limits the prolonged temporary encumbrance of geographical posts by staff members without geographical status and addresses the underlying conditions that enabled such situations to persist. These regulatory changes constitute the review and corrective action envisaged by the recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Under- Secretary-General for Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance has issued a revised administrative instruction on the administration of appointments, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
